market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $115 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$96-100 with strong upward momentum (7 consecutive daily gains). EIA forecasts Brent to peak in Q2 2026 at $115/b (~WTI $110). With Iran/Hormuz tensions and intraday WTI hitting ~$101.81, $115 settlement by end of June is the modal outcome if the disruption persists for several more weeks.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Speed of Hormuz reopening or peace deal that could rapidly cool prices
